column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a spirit” (or “wind”) is rendered “The Spirit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “[one who] spoke to me” is rendered “Him speaking to me.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “this is” before “the place of My throne.”
Close to the Hebrew; “declare … the house” is rendered “describe the temple.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the gutter” is rendered “the base,” and “the mound of the altar” “the height of the altar.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the gutter of the ground” is rendered “the base on the ground.”
Close to the Hebrew; “its gutter” is rendered “its base.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a male goat of goats” is rendered “a kid of the goats.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will fill its hands” is rendered “so consecrate it.”
